SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_Country_CRM] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_Country
AS(
    SELECT
     BCC.[VALUE] AS CountryId
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS IsoCountryName
    ,BCC.[VALUE] AS Iso2LetterCountryCode
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC 
WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'COUNTRY'

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Country FROM TEMP_BNKM_Country;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_Country_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CountryId
,IsoCountryName
,Iso2LetterCountryCode
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, CountryId,FinancialInstitutionId,CATEGORYID
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Country
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Country_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CountryId
,IsoCountryName
,Iso2LetterCountryCode
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, CountryId, FinancialInstitutionId,CATEGORYID
FROM BNKM.Country WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_Country_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CountryId,TGT.CountryId) AS CountryId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CATEGORYID,TGT.CATEGORYID) AS CATEGORYID
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_Country_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_Country_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_Country_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_Country_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET
 CountryId  = SRC.CountryId 
,IsoCountryName  = SRC.IsoCountryName 
,Iso2LetterCountryCode = SRC.Iso2LetterCountryCode
,CategoryId  = SRC.CategoryId 
FROM BNKM.Country TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Country_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Country SRC ON SRC.CountryId = TGT.CountryId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.Country
([CountryId]
,[IsoCountryName]
,[Iso2LetterCountryCode]
,[Iso3LetterCountryCode]
,[Iso3DigitCountryCode]
,[CapitalOrMajorCityName]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     SRC.CountryId AS CountryId
    ,IsoCountryName AS IsoCountryName
    ,Iso2LetterCountryCode AS Iso2LetterCountryCode
    ,NULL AS Iso3LetterCountryCode
    ,NULL AS Iso3DigitCountryCode
    ,NULL AS CapitalOrMajorCityName
    ,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,SRC.CategoryId AS CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_Country SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_Country_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CountryId = SRC.CountryId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CATEGORYID = SRC.CATEGORYID
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Country;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_Country_DELTA;

END
GO
